title: Scalp Alopecia in Female Patients With Metastatic Breast Cancer Treated With Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd) in Combination With a Scalp Cooling Device.
official: Evaluation of Scalp Alopecia in Female Patients With Metastatic Breast Cancer Treated With Trastuzumab Deruxtecan (T-DXd) in Combination With a Scalp Cooling Device.
summary: This study aims to evaluate whether the Paxman© scalp cooling device can reduce alopecia induced by T-DXd treatment at 3 months.

interventions.name: T-DXd treatment with the addition of the PaxMan© device for each cycle of chemotherapy.

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Adult subjects
* Women diagnosed with invasive metastatic breast cancer.
* Presence of hair at the start of the study. Full-dose chemotherapy regimens must be scheduled for at least 4 cycles: Trastuzumab deruxtecan 5.4 mg/kg administered intravenously once every 3 weeks.
* Patient available for 6 months of follow-up.
* Patient enrolled in or covered by a health insurance plan.
* Patient who has provided consent (voluntary, informed, and signed).

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient currently excluded from participation in another study.
* Patient under court-ordered protection, under guardianship, or under conservatorship.
* Patient for whom it is impossible to provide informed consent.
* Pregnant or breastfeeding patient.
